title: Director decision D13 (opening and timeout concession), clock tug-of-war research checkpoint and test-database fixture cleanup
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Engine research for the Director: upstream concede (player move, ignorePriority, other player wins) is valid only in main-game phases; the opening phases allow chooseWhoGoesFirst/alterHand plus the server-only forfeitGame (judge role, named winner, documented for timeout/disconnect forfeits). Official CR 2.2 and CR 2.3 (cached bytes, pdfjs extraction) rule 2.3.3.4: a player who concedes at any point, including Setup or Cleanup, loses. Mulligan: CR 2.2.2 and the engine are sequential (starting player first, then turn order; alterHand enforces priority, NOT_PRIORITY_HOLDER otherwise), so an opening timeout identifies one player.

Director decision D13 recorded: concede allowed at any point including the opening and counted as a loss; after a configurable number of consecutive timeouts the server concedes for that player (loss), replacing D12's no-timeout-winner and opening pause for player timeouts; infrastructure pauses unchanged; implementation assigned to Codex.

Clock research checkpoint (read-only): kernel correction now +3.4% to +3.8% (tick 10337-10384; monotonic +36,374 ppm vs raw) versus -2.76% on 2026-10-14; calendar steps back about 1.05 s every ~29 s as two steps 0.1-0.2 s apart. Host correlation ties the second step to Ubuntu systemd-timesyncd's NTP exchange (active, 32 s minimum poll, 5,875 packets); Windows w32tm stripchart shows Windows about 0.53-0.54 s from public NTP (W32Time Stopped/Manual). Inferred sequence: biased chronyd rate -> Docker/WSL steps to Windows time -> timesyncd re-steps to Internet time; both steps feed chronyd's estimator. Proposed controlled test documented; nothing changed.

RUN-20261018-006 test-database fixture cleanup (test target, restricted match role, project fixture helper): orphaned timed fixture from interrupted RUN-20261015-050 (1 match, 1 clock, 8 clock events, 3 receipts, 3 journal, 3 outbox) and 31 quota rows expired 2026-10-14 removed; all counts 0 after. RUN007 read-only kernel clock probe in the container (child exit 0; receipt clock_changed by design).
Decision register D13; PLAY-04 validation note (decisions, upstream behaviour, cleanup); clock investigation follow-up with measurements and proposed test; handoff.
